chronicle {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} is installed in the namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

Check the Pods:

  kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
{{- if .Values.server.enabled }}

Open the UI at the address of auth.redirectURL without /auth/callback:

  {{ .Values.auth.redirectURL | trimSuffix "/auth/callback" }}
{{- if eq .Values.server.service.type "ClusterIP" }}

The server Service is ClusterIP. Put it behind an ingress, or test it with a port-forward:

  kubectl port-forward -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} svc/{{ include "chronicle.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "server" "context" $) }} 8080:{{ .Values.server.service.port }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
